ignoreValues.reason: Warm cream (#FAF6F1) is the app's deliberate, benchmark-driven base surface across all screens (documented in the design direction: avoids clinical white for a food-subscription product, ties to the persona's home-kitchen framing). Consistent by design across every route, not a per-page reflex default.

Hero text (cream #FAF6F1 and light terracotta #F0916F) on Home only sits over a photographic background image + dark gradient scrim (.home-hero__bg / .home-hero__scrim), not the flat cream page background the static checker reads. Verified visually: strong legibility. Scoped to the root route only (not /deck, /preferencias, etc.) so a real contrast bug elsewhere still surfaces.
